name: Nationalparkhaus Matrei
kurzbeschreibung: The National Park Centre in Matrei in East Tyrol showcases the Tauern Worlds exhibition with interactive insights into alpine flora, fauna, and glaciers.
preis: Adults approx. €7.00, concessions €5.50, children €4.00, family tickets available
oeffnungszeiten: Mid-May to late October Tue–Sun 09:00–17:00 (open daily in July & August)
beschreibung:
Overview

The modern National Park Centre Matrei in East Tyrol serves as the central administrative hub and premier visitor portal for the Tyrolean section of the Hohe Tauern National Park—the largest nature reserve in the entire Alps. Located in the picturesque Isel Valley at the foot of soaring 3,000-metre peaks, this architectural gateway introduces travelers to the uniqueness of fragile alpine ecosystems, rare minerals, and millennia-old natural dynamics. With its award-winning exhibition, the centre is a vital starting point for families, mountaineers, and outdoor enthusiasts seeking an authentic understanding of the protected alpine wilderness before venturing into the high peaks.

Route & Requirements

The centerpiece of the visitor facility is the cutting-edge interactive permanent exhibition Tauern Worlds (Tauernwelten). Spanning two spacious levels, guests embark on an engaging sensory journey through diverse alpine habitats: from rushing glacier brooks in the valleys up to the arctic boulder fields and ice worlds of the Großglockner and Großvenediger massifs. Room-height panoramic projections, a virtual 3D flight across alpine summits, tactile relief maps, and nature soundscapes bring golden eagles, marmots, and ibexes vividly to life. The building is thoroughly barrier-free, offering wide ramps and elevators for visitors using wheelchairs or prams.

Visit & Arrival

The centre welcomes visitors from mid-May through late October: Tuesday to Sunday from 09:00 to 17:00, with daily opening during July and August. Admission fees are approx. €7.00 for adults and €4.00 for children; holders of the Nationalpark Sommercard or Osttirol Card enjoy completely free admission. Arrival by public transport: take the ÖBB bus from Lienz along the Isel Valley directly to the Matrei in Osttirol Korberplatz bus stop, located just two minutes' walk away. Motorists travel via the Felbertauern federal road B108 to Matrei; ample free visitor parking and EV charging stations are available right outside.

Tips

The entrance foyer provides hikers with up-to-the-minute updates on alpine weather conditions, trail status, and open mountain huts throughout the National Park. Take advantage of guided excursions led by certified National Park Rangers into the nearby Zedlach Paradise larch forest or toward the Schlatenkees glacier tongue to spot wildlife in its natural habitat. The gift shop features superb local nature guides and regional craft items.
